title: Added the `freezeBar` plugin, which lets users change the number of frozen rows and columns by dragging a bar on the freeze line or with the keyboard, together with the `beforeFreezeChange` and `afterFreezeChange` hooks and the `getFreezeCount()` and `setFreezeCount()` methods. The sheets bar now keeps the frozen rows of each sheet apart, and a freeze set at runtime no longer follows the user onto a sheet they have not opened.
